label: main season
summary: E1 is indirect evidence from a local source and is a clearance target under the programme criteria; technical survey is not available. E2 supports only four years of trouble-free fishing along one stream and neither meets cancellation criteria nor explains E1. Recommend clearance for sign-off.
flags: The area remains recorded as suspected; this is a recommendation for a person to review and sign off, not a final decision.
The zone survey flag and priority rank are visit-planning information, not evidence.

checks.detail: Every item of the evidence log is in the register.
The national criteria provide no technical survey, so clearance takes its place; evidence to target: E1.

E1.quote: A woodcutter said people stopped using the land on the ridge after an armed group camped there around 2002, and nobody has used it since.
E1.note: A local woodcutter's report of armed-group presence followed by abandonment suggests possible contamination, but does not confirm EO.

E2.quote: A man who hunts and fishes said he started to fish along one of the streams in the area 4 years ago and has had no trouble there.
E2.note: The informant reports his own four years of trouble-free fishing, which supports limited safe use but does not account for E1.
